en.name: Millet, whole grain
en.summary: Whole grain millet keeps about 2 months in a sealed container in the cupboard and 4 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F). That short cupboard window surprises people, and the reason is the germ: millet is comparatively oily for a small grain, and the oil turns long before anything else happens.
en.pantry: Keep it airtight in a cool, dark, dry cupboard and use it within about 2 months. This is one of the shortest pantry lives of any grain, shorter than brown rice, and it is worth planning around — buy the small bag rather than the sack, keep it away from the hob, and do not decant it into a pretty jar on a sunny shelf. Rancid millet is bitter and the bitterness carries straight into the finished porridge, which is why people sometimes decide they dislike millet when what they disliked was old millet.
en.fridge: No refrigerator timeline is published for millet, so none is given. Cold does slow the germ oil from turning, so an airtight jar in the fridge is a sensible home for an opened bag in a warm kitchen — the seal must be real, because small grains take up smells, and a cold jar opened in a humid kitchen collects condensation. Let it warm up before you open it, and stir before measuring.
en.freezer: The freezer roughly doubles it, to about 4 months at −18 °C (0 °F), in an airtight container or a heavy bag with the air pressed out. Freeze it on the day you buy it rather than once you have started to wonder about it, because freezing slows rancidity but does not reverse it. Cook it straight from frozen; there is no need to thaw a grain. Frozen food stays safe indefinitely at −18 °C; the months are about quality.
spoilage: A bitter, paint-like smell — rancid germ oil, and the usual end of millet.
A musty or damp smell, or clumping in what should be free-running grain.
Webbing, small moths or fine dust in the jar.
Porridge that tastes bitter however it is sweetened or salted.
tips: Buy small; two months is short for a grain you use occasionally.
Toast a spoonful and smell it if you are unsure — heat brings out rancidity.
Freeze a big bag on the day of purchase.
Store it away from the stove and out of the light.

faq.a: About 2 months airtight in a cool, dark cupboard, or 4 months at −18 °C (0 °F).

faq.q: Why does millet go off so fast?
faq.a: Its germ is relatively oily for a small grain, and that oil turns rancid before anything else goes wrong.
Yes, about 4 months at −18 °C in an airtight container, and you can cook it straight from frozen.

zh.name: 小米
zh.summary: 全粒小米密封放櫥櫃約 2 個月，−18 °C 冷凍 4 個月。這麼短的櫥櫃期限常讓人意外，原因在胚芽：以這麼小的穀物來說小米算是偏油的，而油脂會在其他問題發生之前就先變質。
zh.pantry: 密封放陰涼、避光、乾燥的櫥櫃，約 2 個月內用完。這是所有穀物裡櫥櫃壽命最短的之一，比糙米還短，值得先規劃好——買小包不要買大袋、遠離爐台，也不要為了好看把它裝進玻璃罐擺在有陽光的層架上。走了油耗的小米會苦，而那個苦味會原封不動跑進煮好的粥裡；有些人以為自己不喜歡小米，其實不喜歡的是放太久的小米。
zh.fridge: 小米沒有公布的冷藏期限，所以本頁不給。低溫確實能延緩胚芽油脂變質，所以溫暖的廚房裡，開封後裝密封罐放冰箱是合理的做法——密封必須是真的，因為小顆粒的穀物很會吸味道，而冰冷的罐子在潮濕廚房打開會結露。開封前先回溫，量取前先攪鬆。
zh.freezer: 冷凍大致讓時間加倍，−18 °C 下約 4 個月，裝密封容器或厚袋壓出空氣。要凍就買回來當天凍，不要等到你開始懷疑它才凍，因為冷凍能延緩油耗卻無法逆轉。要煮直接從冷凍下鍋，穀物不必解凍。−18 °C 下安全性是無限期的，月數講的是品質。
spoilage: 聞到苦味或油漆味——胚芽油走油耗，也是小米最常見的結局。
有潮霉味，或本該鬆散的米粒結塊。
罐內出現絲網、小蛾或細粉屑。
煮成的粥不管加糖加鹽都帶苦味。
tips: 買小包；對偶爾才吃的穀物來說，兩個月很短。
不確定就乾鍋炒一小匙聞聞看——加熱會把油耗味逼出來。
大包裝買回來當天就冷凍。

faq.a: 密封、陰涼避光的櫥櫃約 2 個月，或 −18 °C 冷凍 4 個月。

faq.q: 小米為什麼壞得這麼快？
faq.a: 以這麼小的穀物來說它的胚芽偏油，而那些油脂會在其他問題之前先走油耗。
可以，−18 °C 下密封容器約 4 個月，而且能直接從冷凍下鍋煮。
